verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since template libraries are a fair question for a workflow-automation product, but nothing in the pack documents a public library of Zap or workflow templates. The closest items are MCP tool bundles (zapier-docs-30), which are privately shared links to tool lists rather than a public workflow template library. A community comment about Zapier's integration pages helping people find solutions (zapier-comm-7) is too vague to count as templates.
